candidate.scope: Illumina Quartz-Seq whole-transcript-amplification schematic: one single-cell polyadenylated-RNA-to-enriched-cDNA route, interpreted against Sasagawa et al. (2013). The scope ends at the drawn cDNA product; the primary-paper sequencing interface explains its use without adding unshown library-preparation operations. Quartz-Chip, later Quartz-Seq versions, similar-method catalogue names, and the modified zebrafish application are not additional targets of this schematic.

operations.label: Reverse transcription and Primer digestion
operations.description: Reverse transcription copies the RNA into first-strand cDNA. Exonuclease I then digests most unused RT primer, reducing the precursor to primer-derived byproducts while retaining the copied cDNA.
operations.mechanism: RNA-templated DNA synthesis followed by exonuclease I digestion of residual single-stranded DNA primer.
operations.information_effect: Transcript sequence is now carried by complementary DNA; retained sample provenance associates that DNA with the originating cell. Primer digestion reduces artifacts without guaranteeing their complete absence.

operations.description: Amplify the cDNA using WTA primer-binding sequences while suppressing amplification of short DNA byproducts, yielding the final depicted enriched cDNA.
